name: okta
_status: TEMPLATE, UNTESTED: built from Okta documentation, never run against an org.
notes: acr_values urn:okta:loa:2fa:any asks for any two factors. Unsupported values are ignored by Okta, so the client and API must still check the returned acr.
max_age is supported; max_age=0 forces re-authentication (Classic Engine uses max_age=1).
acr and auth_time appear in the ID token and the documented access token example. Okta uses error=unmet_authentication_requirements on the callback when the level cannot be met.
The exact acr strings in issued tokens must be confirmed against a real org.
